narrator.name: Model Monica
narrator.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I walked through the nightly retraining pipeline this morning. The acceptance criteria for the new seasonal models sit in a separate spreadsheet maintained by the category team. The evaluation harness that runs against the test set does not reference that file. I ran the standard validation suite for the heatwave scenario. The harness printed its usual pass or fail summary based on internal thresholds. I then compared those results to the spreadsheet manually. There is no script or log entry that connects the two. The model version deployed to production was tagged by the deployment tool without any check against the external criteria list. The process relies on a human opening both documents side by side to confirm alignment before the next cycle.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current state of the pipeline and the absence of automated checks without expressing any specific wish, refusal, or acceptance by the author.
